parsedVerdict.reasoning: The file is an Express error-handling middleware. Its only job is to translate errors into HTTP responses. It maps DomainError codes to HTTP status codes, handles JSON parse errors (SyntaxError) and falls back to a 500 response. All of this is transport and framework work, which belongs in the infrastructure layer. The file contains no business rules: it does not decide when an error happens or validate anything about the domain. It only translates errors that other code has already raised. There is no persistence logic, and no ADR prose was given that would contradict this.
